data.name: Charge Bolt
data.effect: Spell attack. d6 dice. On a critical, target is Off-Guard until your next turn.

data.name: Mend
data.effect: Repair one broken non-magical object of your grade or below.

data.name: Reading Light
data.effect: Light to the Near zone for an hour. In brume it reveals which way the fog thins.

data.name: Ward Sigil
data.effect: Target gains +1 AC for one minute. Ends early if the target falls unconscious.

data.name: Consecrate Water
data.effect: One flask deals 2 dice of d6 radiant to the unfixed and the undead.

data.name: Mercy
data.effect: Restore (1d8 + Combat EL) x RGM hit points, or stabilise a Dying creature.

data.name: Steady Hand
data.effect: One ally rerolls a failed save. Once per ally per encounter.

data.name: Borrowed Face
data.effect: Appear as another person of similar build for an hour. Touch breaks it.

data.name: Dread
data.effect: On a failure, Frightened 1. On a critical failure, Frightened 2 and it must withdraw.

data.name: Disarm
data.effect: On a failure the target drops one held item into your zone.

data.name: Set Against the Charge
data.effect: Until your next turn, the first enemy to enter your zone takes a free Strike.

data.name: Read the Swell
data.effect: Know the weather and current for the coming watch. +2 to the party's Navigate.

data.name: Speak with Beasts
data.effect: Converse with any non-sapient creature for ten minutes. It answers as it understands.

data.name: Thornlash
data.effect: d6 dice. On a failed save the target is also Immobilized until it Escapes.

data.name: Charge Sight
data.effect: For an hour you see Possibility: charge, sigils, brume density and recent binding.

data.name: Concussive Sigil
data.effect: d6 dice to every creature in one zone. Half on a success.

data.name: Lock the Air
data.effect: One creature is Immobilized for one minute. It may Escape at the end of each turn.

data.name: Compel Truth
data.effect: On a failure the target cannot knowingly lie for one minute. It knows it is bound.

data.name: Shield of the Making
data.effect: An ally gains temporary HP equal to Combat EL x RGM for one minute.

data.name: Bind Shadow
data.effect: The target's shadow is pinned. It is Immobilized while you concentrate.

data.name: Whisper of Doubt
data.effect: On a failure the target's next roll is one degree worse.

data.name: Boarding Hook
data.effect: Drag a creature or yourself between zones. On a critical the target is Prone.

data.name: Feint
data.effect: Deception vs the target's Will DC. On a success it is Off-Guard until your next turn.

data.name: Second Wind
data.effect: Regain (2d8 + Combat EL) x RGM hit points. Once per long rest.

data.name: Beast Form
data.effect: Take a beast shape for ten minutes: swim or climb Speed, +2 AC, unarmed Strikes.

data.name: Summon Squall
data.effect: One zone is heavily obscured for a minute. Ranged attacks through it have disadvantage.

data.name: Dispel Charge
data.effect: End one magical effect of your tier or below. Higher tiers require a check.

data.name: Overpressure
data.effect: d8 dice to every creature in two adjacent zones. Structures take double.

data.name: Sigil of Return
data.effect: Mark a place. Once within a week you may return to it from anywhere in the region.

data.name: Pillar of Judgement
data.effect: d8 dice radiant in one zone. Enemies failing are also Frightened 2.

data.name: Restoration
data.effect: Remove one condition: Drained, Enfeebled, Fatigued, Blinded, or a disease.

data.name: Curse of Small Failures
data.effect: For an hour the target's critical successes count as ordinary successes.

data.name: Steal a Memory
data.effect: Take one memory. You gain what it knew. The target does not notice for a day.

data.name: Riposte
data.effect: When an attack against you misses, make a Strike. Costs your reaction.

data.name: Unbreakable
data.effect: For one minute, the first time you would drop to 0 you drop to 1 instead.

data.name: Whirlwind
data.effect: One Strike against every creature in your zone at no penalty.

data.name: Bond of the Pack
data.effect: Summon a beast that fights as a Standard of your grade for one minute.

data.name: Call the Deep
data.effect: Water floods a zone. Creatures failing are Prone and Slowed 1 while it lasts.

data.name: Fold the Deck
data.effect: Move yourself and all allies in Engaged one zone in any direction, instantly.

data.name: Ruin
data.effect: d10 dice to one creature, or d8 dice to a zone. Ignores one grade of the damage gate.

data.name: Break the Curse
data.effect: Remove any curse, hex or persistent condition of your tier or below.

data.name: Sanctuary of the Wright
data.effect: A zone becomes safe ground: no ambient damage, and rest is possible for one watch regardless of grade.

data.name: Rewrite a Debt
data.effect: Transfer one obligation, oath or curse from one willing creature to another.

data.name: Terror
data.effect: Every enemy in a zone is Frightened 3. Critical failure means they flee for one minute.

data.name: Duelist's Reckoning
data.effect: Challenge one creature. While you both fight only each other, your Strikes gain a die.

data.name: Storm of Steel
data.effect: Three Strikes at -2 each, distributed as you choose within your zone.

data.name: Green Growth
data.effect: Make barren ground fertile for a season. On an island this is a political act.

data.name: Leviathan's Wake
data.effect: Something vast passes beneath. d10 dice to a zone; vessels take a breach on a critical failure.

data.name: Charge Cascade
data.effect: d10 dice in a zone. It then jumps to an adjacent zone at one die fewer, twice.

data.name: Unmake Structure
data.effect: One structure, wall or vessel section of your grade or below simply ceases to hold together.

data.name: Mass Mercy
data.effect: Every ally in Near regains (3d8 + Combat EL) x RGM hit points.

data.name: Word of Binding
data.effect: One creature of Elite role or below is held motionless for one minute or until damaged.

data.name: Foretell
data.effect: Ask one yes-or-no question about the coming watch. The answer is honest but not complete.

data.name: Puppet
data.effect: One creature of Standard role or below acts on your turn for one minute.

data.name: One Against Many
data.effect: Until your next turn, every enemy that attacks you and misses takes a free Strike in return.

data.name: The Killing Ground
data.effect: Choose a zone. For one minute, enemies there are Slowed 1 and you have advantage against them.

data.name: Turn the Weather
data.effect: Set the weather across the region for a full watch. Travel doubles or halves.

data.name: Engine of the Self
data.effect: You need no food, sleep or air for a season, and ambient damage cannot reduce you below 1.

data.name: Rewrite the Local Rule
data.effect: Suspend one physical law in the region for one minute: gravity, sound, the tide, the passage of heat.

data.name: Raise the Fallen
data.effect: Return a creature dead less than a week. It returns Wounded 3 and remembers being gone.

data.name: Erase from Memory
data.effect: Every creature in the region forgets one event, person or place for a month.

data.name: Cut the Line
data.effect: One Strike. If it kills, immediately Stride to any enemy in Near and Strike again. Repeats.

data.name: The Last Stand
data.effect: When reduced to 0, act one more time at full capability before falling. Once per grade.

data.name: Summon the Deep Thing
data.effect: Call a creature that fights as a Boss of one grade below yours, for one minute.

data.name: Edit
data.effect: Change one fact established in this scene. It was always that way. Once per grade.

data.name: Fix the Unfixed
data.effect: Settle an uncharted region permanently without surveying it. It yields no Discovery, and it never will again.

data.name: Consecrate the Sea
data.effect: A whole region becomes safe ground: no ambient damage, full rest, for a week.

data.name: The Long Doom
data.effect: Name a creature anywhere in the sea. It knows. It has one year, and it knows that too.

data.name: Nothing Stands
data.effect: One Strike against every creature in Engaged and Near, each at full bonus, each dealing maximum damage.

data.name: Wake the Island
data.effect: The island itself moves. Where it goes and what it wants are not yours to decide.
